title: Seminar: Advanced Topics of Quantum Computing (TUM, Modul NAT5040m)
titleEn: Seminar: Topics of Quantum Computing (TUM, Module NAT5040m)
description: The formalism of quantum mechanics represents a paradigm shift for elementary operations, like applying unitary quantum gates, compared to classical computers. In the seminar "Advanced Topics of Quantum Computing", students investigate current state-of-the-art quantum algorithms, their underlying mathematical description and theoretical analysis, and associated methods to (numerically) simulate the functionality of a quantum computer.
